resources.string: Follow the system language, or choose a language for Natsuko. Unsupported system languages use English.
Automatically save finished images, PDFs, GIFs, and videos to the directory below.
Outputs are organized by feature and processing time.
The default directory needs no additional storage permission. When choosing another directory, allow access in the system picker. Turning this off keeps previously saved outputs.
